caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #132: ABSTRUSE

abstruse (adjective): very hard to understand.

✅ In a sentence: The lecture on quantum field theory was so abstruse that most of the audience stopped taking notes.
✅ Similar: obscure, esoteric, recondite
✅ Remember it: Think "abstract + obtuse": hard to get.
